title: Add chatty to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [chatty](https://chatty.ext.io) to chat
- simple chat ui that uses pollinations and new byop system [models are a bit outdated will prob update sometime]

Fixes #12701

gist.headline: A chatty new flower
gist.blurb: Chatty has joined the chat garden: a simple conversational UI built on Pollinations and the new BYOP system. The models may be due for a future watering, but the interface is already blooming.
gist.summary: Added Chatty, a simple chat interface at chatty.ext.io that uses Pollinations and the new BYOP system, to the community app directories.
gist.impact: People looking for a lightweight Pollinations-powered chat UI can now discover Chatty directly from the project’s app listings.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Chatty as a cozy retro chat terminal growing from a flower pot, with friendly speech bubbles and small code-plants around it. Polli should hover beside the terminal wearing tiny headphones, warmly tending the new chat flower; the monitor robot can eagerly watch messages appear on screen.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-hackerspace where Polli, the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, black antennae, oval black eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings, wears tiny headphones while tending a flower pot holding a retro chat terminal labeled "CHATTY." A cute CRT monitor robot watches friendly chat bubbles bloom into code-flowers beside her; prominently use lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach with dark purple (#110518) outlines. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
